mentions.name: Travel agency (boa.ba / dobosnia.com)
mentions.description: A travel agency the author runs, made viable with the help of agents that manage ads, social media, and website content. The first site, boa.ba, went quite well, and a new site at dobosnia.com is being prepared.
mentions.source_excerpt: Apart from that, running a travel agency I'd never be able to without agents (they manage my ads, social media, website content etc.). Started with boa.ba and it went quite well, now preparing dobosnia.com
mentions.author: ribice
